Published PC image evidence for [[Haven (PC 2024 D-E1 card)]], [[Haven (PC Errata 2)]] and [[Haven (PC Errata 3)]]. Comparison of complete2017 composed region, initial preserved full E and later official D-E1 full face; each is proportionally resized on a labeled white canvas. The comparison retains the printed content of each source image. Import/source dates are not first-publication dates.

Card design and artwork copyright as printed on the official source; original Decipher design, PC errata rendition. Used to identify and study the published card versions on this non-commercial fan wiki.
